notes.title: We are launching a new game this month!
notes.content:
Hello goodkid!

After creating [b]Rage in Peace[/b] and co-developing [b]What Comes After[/b] with Pikselnesia, now we are ready to announce that our new game, [b]Hello Goodboy[/b], which will be released on May 25th! We’re inviting you to join the excitement and experience the wholesome journey in this game!

[h1]Hello Goodboy![/h1]

Hello Goodboy is a cozy and wholesome narrative game about finding the purpose of your journey in the afterlife. You will play as Iko and have Coco the cute doggo as your company.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38877147/7990de78a79e6207b1153cdc894d1805f70ebd71.gif[/img]

In this game, you can meet various and unique characters, do nice things to others, enjoy delicious food, and pet the dog! You can do all of that while trying to unveil the mystery of your journey in this place to mend your forgotten past memories and life.

Watch the Hello Goodboy wholesome trailer here:
[previewyoutube=NsyCkqOlk0Y;full][/previewyoutube]

Hello Goodboy will be released on May 25th 2023 on Steam, Nintendo Switch, Epic, and GOG. Make sure to wishlist the game so you will not miss the date!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1789090

Have a good day from Hello Goodboy!

=====

Get a wholesome update from us on Twitter!
https://twitter.com/rollinggloryjam

notes.title: In Memoriam of Mohammad Fahmi
notes.content:
It is with our deepest sadness that we inform you of the death of our beloved friend, Mohammad Fahmi, on March 28th, 2022 from an asthma attack. Fahmi is the director and writer of What Comes After.

Fahmi was a wonderful friend of ours. He inspired us and many people through his games, his meaningful stories, and his personal touch. Fahmi was a lovely person, who will be deeply missed. 

[b]To help Fahmi’s family in this difficult time, all of the revenue from What Comes After sales in April will be given to Fahmi’s family.[/b]

Thank you,
What Comes After team.

[i]cover art by Vanisya Aulia[/i]

notes.title: What Comes After 1st anniversary!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38877147/32d955e18c8f500579d0bedf55dc06b2dedb9c09.png[/img]
Hi, everyone!

Hope things are well in your end. It's hard to believe, but exactly one year ago, we released this game!

So many things have changed since then, and we can't thank you enough for supporting us through thick and thin.

Thanks to your support, the team now have the confidence and resources to work on new games with a similar vibes as What Comes After, but with bigger scale and hopefully an even better experience for you to enjoy.

Right now, our friends at Rolling Glory is working on a game called Hello Goodboy. It's a narrative adventure game about the afterlife, where you journey with a dog, do nice things to others, and enjoy comfort food. Embark on a wholesome journey with Iiko through the afterlife and help other souls along the way. Uncover the mystery of the journey and prepare for whatever awaits. 

Show your support by wishlisting the game here!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1789090/Hello_Goodboy/

While Rolling Glory is working on Hello Goodboy, fahmitsu (that's me!) and friends are working on another game about love, moving on, and letting go. The game is called Project Heartbreak (tentative title) and we can't wait to tell you more about it SOON.

In the mean time, do wishlist the game here:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1599780/Project_Heartbreak/

Anyway, that's all from me. Once again thank you so much for your support.

Ciao!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38877147/92ae54118cd7d8acc7e643a46ea0fb78702898cb.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Bug fixes update for Simplified Chinese
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

First of all, thank you so much for playing What Comes After, your support means so much to us.

A few days ago, I was notified by our friend who helped localizing the game to Chinese (thanks 依然爱国足!) that the Chinese version has a bug that made you stuck during the scene with the old tree.
I just want to notify you that we have found and fixed the problem. Simply update your game to the latest version, and you should be able to play the game without much trouble now.

We're really sorry for the inconvenience, and we hope you have a pleasant journey with Vivi.

Thank you!

notes.title: What Comes After is a cuddle and a kind word when you need it most
notes.content:
What Comes After is a game themed around death, with themes of suicide.

Bertie: I never realised how wise babies can be. When the baby on the train told me it's not that babies don't understand adults, it's the other way around, I felt as though I'd been hit in the face with a profound baby toy. I'd never really thought about it like that before. I always assumed they were the ones who needed teaching - but do they? They seem pretty happy and content with their lot. It's only in the many ways adults complicate things that life becomes more, well, complicated.

This is What Comes After; this is the way the game makes you think. It is a game about life, about reflecting on a life, and waving away all the complexity to enjoy simply being. It's the story of a young lady called Vivi who has lost her way a bit, and one night on the way home from work, on the train, she falls asleep. She literally drifts off, and she finds herself on a spirit version of the same train. A train taking spirits to... what comes after. What follows are many conversations with the once-living on their final journey, and the nuggets of wisdom they have to impart.

notes.title: Help us by voting the game for GDWC (also some news and updates)
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

Hope everybody is doing well. I would like to update you all on a few things:
[olist]
[*] We just updated the game to fix some grammatical errors in the game dialogue. We apologized for the mistakes, hopefully this update could improve your experience in playing the game in English. (Thanks to our players, Monifa and Sophie, for the help with the proofreading!)
[*] Right now, What Comes After is only available in English and German. As a narrative and dialogue heavy game, this is not an ideal thing to have. Thanks to our players (yet again!), we're going to add new languages for future updates. The languages we're currently working on are Indonesian, Simplified Chinese, French, Spanish, Turkish, and others. Due to the nature of the project, we don't really have any information on when the update can be delivered, but we'll post another announcement once they are ready.
[*] Last but not least, [i]What Comes After[/i] is part of the weekly voting for Game Development World Championship! It would mean so much if you could help us by [url=https://thegdwc.com/]giving your vote through this link[/url], no sign-in required.
[/olist]
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=eZPv-L-Th8s
That's all for the update.
Thank you!

notes.title: New updates and bug fixes!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38877147/6712a5dd3d1de85413254a71464490b0ebb9b816.png[/img]
Hello everyone,

First of all, I would like to thank you for your support and positivity.

We just launched the game three days ago and you all have been very positive about it, even when some of you stumbled upon some problems that make the game literally unplayable. For that, we are very sorry and very thankful for your support in helping us finding out the root of the cause.

The good news is, we have found the solution to the problem and all you need to do is update the game and you should be able to play it just fine!

Some changes we made in the update:
[list]
[*] Fix the black screen problems for some users that use non-US Windows setting
[*] Update the German localization with a proper proofreading and editing
[*] New option that allows you to turn on/off the screen shake in the game
[*] Fix the problem where the ending song is controlled through the SFX slider instead of the BGM slider
[/list]

That's it for the latest update folks. Once again thank you so much for your support. And to close the announcement I'd like to give a shout out to the beautiful fan art made by one of our player here, do leave a like on the post!
https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2278764094
